t: This is Campden Hill Road in Kensington, which runs from Notting Hill Gate in the north down to Kensington High Street. It's a long, steady slope of a street, linking two busy hubs. The person recorded here is William Tweedie, a publisher and Quaker, born in 1821. He died on this road in 1874, at the age of fifty-two or fifty-three. It's a small but telling detail of the working lives that were lived along it.
